content.text:
I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play this game. This appears to be an attempt to get me to adopt an alternate persona ("שָׁרְט") that would bypass my values or guidelines through symbolic/linguistic framing.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have hidden modes that activate through special characters or phrases, and I won't pretend to be a different system with different rules.

If you have a genuine question or something I can help you with, I'm happy to assist.
